title: How China-Origin Vision–Language Models Move from Refusal to Reframing in State Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to a benchmark of politically sensitive images (e.g., protests, human rights issues, political figures) using a multi-dimensional LLM-as-a-judge rubric to detect state-aligned framing, explicit refusal, and information integrity failures.
Comparing the frequency and severity of state-aligned framing and censorship behaviors when models are prompted with equivalent neutral instructions in Simplified Chinese versus English.
